name: Blackwall and Silvertown tunnels charge
law: The Silvertown Tunnel Order 2018 (user charges set by TfL): heavy goods vehicles (N2, N3) pay GBP 10.50 per crossing either way, 06:00-22:00 every day except Christmas Day, paid online or by phone; with `etc` the Auto Pay off-peak price, GBP 5.25 (Auto Pay's peak, weekdays 06:00-10:00 northbound and 16:00-19:00 southbound, is the full price, not modelled). From 2026-09-21 (TfL).

sources.title: Transport for London: paying the Blackwall and Silvertown tunnels charge (read in Chrome, as TfL refuses the workflow)
TfL press release PN-215 (23 July 2026): current and new user charges

vehicles: Heavy goods vehicles (N2, N3: over 3.5 t)
tolled_roads: The Blackwall Tunnel (A102) and the Silvertown Tunnel under the Thames, each bore, either way.
